hook: Teachers from *197* Model Schools sit in at school directorate
hook_b: Teachers from *197* Model Schools sit in at school directorate
tldr: Model School staff protested at the Directorate of School Education on Tuesday, asking the state to pay salaries under the 010 head of account.

beats.what: The Model School Teachers' Joint Action Committee called the sit-in; teachers raised slogans and sang songs about their demands.
beats.why: Paying under the 010 head means salaries come from the state's regular salary budget line, which teachers want.
beats.care: Other demands: compassionate appointments, promotions and transfers, notional benefits for TGTs, and junior lecturer pay scales for PGTs.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 17): 'Tension prevailed' at the directorate as a large number of teachers gathered.

cards.q: What should the government settle first for Model School teachers?

qs: How many Model School teachers are paid outside the 010 head today?

facts.t: Teachers say *five* DA instalments are pending.

viz.verdict: Several pay and service demands at once

viz.l: Model Schools' staff joined the sit-in

learn.t: 010 head = the state budget line for regular salaries, like other government staff

watch: Whether the School Education department responds to the JAC's demands.

fact: Teachers from *197* Telangana Model Schools staged a sit-in in Hyderabad
twist: Their list includes five pending DA instalments, plus gratuity and family pension for families of teachers who died.
